pages.text:
Come in out of the open. There -- that is better.

You will want to know where the god is. Everyone does.

She is not here. She has not been for a long time, and I would rather tell you plainly
than let you work it out from how people go quiet.

She died getting others out. Not fighting -- getting others out. The thing that took
her was put down later, by someone louder, and he is very welcome to the story.
Ours is the running.

So learn this before anything else. Your speed is not for you. It is for the one
behind you who does not have it. Anybody can be brave in one direction.

Then you carry who you can, and you come back. You always come back.

Go and let the sentry at the south gate write your name down. It matters that
somebody knows it.
You came back. Good. That is the whole lesson, really.
